answer: Vesting with clawback: an agent's earnings sit locked at the wharf for several weeks before they can be spent. If audits later tie the account to a duplicate cluster, everything still unvested is clawed back. Honest agents still collect the nectar, only later. A sybil farm must keep hundreds of fakes undetected for the whole vesting window, while each new flag cracks the operation like shale and wipes out its locked pay. Attacks become slow, illiquid bets that one exposure can wipe out.
